# Lab title: a measurable outcome

Describe the skill the reader will practice and estimated time.

## Before you start

- Tools and versions
- Disposable environment and permissions
- Downloads or costs
- Context checks before any cluster changes

## Create practice resources

Use distinctive resource names. Stop if they already exist.
Include complete language-tagged examples, without shell prompts.

## Observe

Include expected output and explain which question each command answers.

## Practice

Change one thing, observe the result, and explain how to recover.
Clearly label mutations. Never assume a failed container has logs.

## Verify

Give concrete checkpoints, not just “it works.”

## Clean up

Delete only this lab's resources. Call out irreversible actions.

## References

Link to official docs and one related KubeDaily guide.
Record your tested tool versions and environment in the pull request.
